system.print('[BIMTEST] BUILD 2 (21:23:01) onStart begin') -- DU link slots are DIRECT globals (slot1..slot10), NOT members of _G. local slots = {} slots[1]=slot1 slots[2]=slot2 slots[3]=slot3 slots[4]=slot4 slots[5]=slot5 slots[6]=slot6 slots[7]=slot7 slots[8]=slot8 slots[9]=slot9 slots[10]=slot10 local screens = 0 for i = 1, 10 do local s = slots[i] if s ~= nil then local cls = '?'; pcall(function() cls = tostring(s.getClass()) end) local nm = '?'; pcall(function() nm = tostring(s.getName()) end) local hasHTML = (type(s.setHTML) == 'function') local hasVol = (type(s.getItemsVolume) == 'function') system.print(string.format('[BIMTEST] slot%d class=%s name=%s setHTML=%s vol=%s', i, cls, nm, tostring(hasHTML), tostring(hasVol))) if hasHTML then pcall(function() if s.activate then s.activate() end end) local html = "
" .. "
BIMTEST OK
" .. "
build 2 (21:23:01)
" .. "
setHTML works on slot" .. i .. "
" .. "
" local ok, err = pcall(function() s.setHTML(html) end) system.print(string.format('[BIMTEST] setHTML slot%d ok=%s err=%s', i, tostring(ok), tostring(err))) screens = screens + 1 end end end system.print('[BIMTEST] screens written = ' .. screens) if screens == 0 then system.print('[BIMTEST] NO element with setHTML found -- is a Screen linked?') end -- Also mirror to the HUD (works when you run the board with F). if system.setScreen then pcall(function() system.showScreen(1) end) pcall(function() system.setScreen("
BIMTEST HUD build 2 (21:23:01)
") end) system.print('[BIMTEST] HUD setScreen attempted') end if unit and unit.setTimer then unit.setTimer('t', 2) end
